dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Shows the current status of DevGatewayDNS.
dashboard.interfacesDescription: Detected NICs. The listen icon indicates addresses where the server is accepting connections.
dashboard.healthDescription: Checks whether each service port is bound and responding.
proxy.title: Proxy Rules
proxy.ipHint: If Forward To IP is empty, requests are forwarded to the machine running DevGatewayDNS.
proxy.hostnameHint: Enter the domain name clients will access in the browser. Use *.example.com to match all subdomains. Exact rules take priority over wildcards.
proxy.description: Set the domain name clients will access in the browser and the destination (IP and port) to forward requests to. DNS records and SSL certificates are generated automatically.
dns.title: DNS Records
dns.description: A records linked to proxy rules are generated automatically (read-only). You can add other records manually.
dns.name: Domain Name
dns.nameHint: The domain name to match in DNS queries
dns.valueHint: Enter the value appropriate for the selected record type
dns.ttlHint: Cache duration in seconds. 300 is fine for most cases.
certs.title: Certificate Management
certs.description: Manages SSL certificates required for HTTPS access. Host certificates are generated automatically when proxy rules are added.
certs.caDescription: Install this CA certificate on client devices to trust all SSL certificates issued by DevGatewayDNS. Required for HTTPS access.
certs.qrcodeDescription: Scan with a smartphone camera to open the CA certificate installation screen.
certs.guide.ios: Settings > General > Profile > Install the downloaded profile, then Settings > General > About > Certificate Trust Settings > Enable.
certs.guide.android: Settings > Security > Install from storage > Select the downloaded certificate.
certs.guide.windows: Double-click the .crt file > Install Certificate > Local Machine > Trusted Root Certification Authorities.
certs.guide.macos: Double-click the .crt file > Add to Keychain > Always Trust.
certs.hostCertsDescription: Certificates automatically issued for each proxy rule. Expired certificates are auto-renewed during daily maintenance.
status.title: Status Monitor
status.description: Monitor HTTP access through the proxy and DNS queries in real-time.
settings.title: System Settings
settings.description: Configure DevGatewayDNS behavior. Changes to ports or listen addresses take effect after a service restart.
settings.upstreamDnsHint: Comma-separated. Queries not matching manual/auto records are forwarded here.
settings.queryHistorySizeHint: Number of recent queries shown in the Status Monitor.
settings.accessLogRetentionDaysHint: Logs older than this are automatically deleted during daily maintenance.
settings.restartRequired: Port or listen address has been changed. Restart required to apply.
